gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.beverguh: Rarity: Only in the Beaver Brook
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.beverguh: A chestnut-brown guh with two orange buck teeth and a flat scaly tail. Nibbles anything made of wood (your door too, sorry vads). Lives in the Beaver Brook among the beavers. Tame it with cheese nibbles, njeg!
